removeRepo.confirm:
Remove {name} from DevDigest?

This only removes it from DevDigest (and its imported PRs). Nothing is deleted on GitHub, and your local clone on disk is left untouched.

severity._comment: Keyed by the contract vocabulary (CRITICAL | WARNING | SUGGESTION); the words are the reviewer-facing ones. CRITICAL reads 'blocker' here because that is what it does to the gate — same word as countBlockers and the PR-list blockers count.
